statement: Replace the sharp interface by a thin layer of thickness delta carrying the C1 mismatch variables.
A positive layer stiffness matrix K gives an effective mismatch energy after integrating through the layer.
The conjugate interface force generated by the layer is the derivative with respect to the mismatch.
Define the compliance matrix C_delta=delta K^-1.
If K remains positive and delta -> 0, z -> 0 while lambda can remain finite.
The stored layer energy vanishes for finite lambda in the hard-constraint limit.
The 3194 gluing multipliers are recovered as finite reaction forces of the vanishing layer.
This is not yet parent-signed: MTS must derive K, delta scaling, localization, and coupling universality.
